title: calostephane punctulata
intro: Calostephane punctulata, commonly known as "pincushion flower", is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues, such as inflammation and pain, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Calostephane punctulata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
